_doc: Single source of truth for code coverage thresholds. See REPO-STANDARDS-SPEC [COVERAGE-THRESHOLDS-JSON]. NO GitHub repo variables. NO env vars. This file is read by the internal _coverage_check recipe inside make test. make test exits non-zero if measured < threshold. Thresholds ratchet UP only.

conformance._doc: Required PEP conformance pass percentage. POLICY: conformance must be 100% — any file that fails the official python/typing calculator tanks the PR. conformance/score.py tracks the LATEST python/typing@main (it resolves and re-downloads the suite on every run — in CI and on release — recording the exact graded commit in website/src/_data/conformance_report.json), so 100% means the checker passes every test in the current upstream suite. The score is computed by the REAL calculator: score.py imports upstream_main.py and runs its get_expected_errors + diff_expected_errors unmodified; a file passes only when upstream's errors_diff is empty, counting every diagnostic the binary emits (errors AND warnings). The binary runs in its default configuration — the pure PEP conformance set; Basilisk's opt-in house-style rules never run during scoring (see [CHKARCH-CONFIGURATION-ONLY]). DISABLING, DELETING, or UNREGISTERING a conformance rule, hand-editing conformance_status.csv, or loosening this gate to fake a pass is forbidden — close every gap by FIXING the checker. Ratchet UP only; now pinned at the 100% target. (History: a 2026-06-26 baseline reset corrected a gamed fake 100% that had disabled six house rules.) See [CHKARCH-CONFORMANCE].
conformance._fp_ceiling_doc: Maximum total false-positive diagnostics across the suite (diagnostics Basilisk reports on a line the suite does NOT mark # E, or outside a satisfied # E[tag] group). POLICY: zero — a single false positive tanks the PR. Enforced via conformance/score.py --gate (run on the compiled binary by scripts/test-rust.sh inside make test). Ratchet DOWN only; now at the 0 target. Close every gap by fixing the checker, never by disabling a rule.
